BETTERGUAC.ERROR_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Please enter a valid email address. New accounts sign in with their email address.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_SERVER_HOST: Enter the server's host name or IP address.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_SERVER_HOST_SPACES: The host name can't contain spaces.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_SERVER_PORT: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_ASSIGN_LOAD: The list of users couldn't be loaded.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_AVATAR_TYPE: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_AVATAR_FILE_SIZE: That picture is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_AVATAR_TOO_BIG: That picture couldn't be made small enough. Try a simpler one.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_NAME_TOO_LONG: Names can be at most 64 characters.
BETTERGUAC.FIELD_OWN_PROFILE: Can edit their own profile and password
BETTERGUAC.HELP_SSH_KEY_FILE: Path on the BetterGuac server, in /etc/betterguac/keys. Leave empty to sign in with the password.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_SSH_KEY_LEGACY: This server has a pasted key from before. Save the key as a file in /etc/betterguac/keys and enter its path here; the pasted key is removed when you save.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_NICKNAME: If you fill this in, it's the name BetterGuac greets you by. Otherwise it uses your first name.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_EMAIL_READONLY: This is the email you sign in with. An admin can change it.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_EMAIL_NOT_YET: This account signs in with its username, and that keeps working. New accounts use an email address.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_PROFILE_LOCKED: Your account isn't allowed to change its own profile. Ask an admin.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ROLE_ADMIN: Manages users and servers, assigns servers to users, and can open every server.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ROLE_USER: Opens only the servers assigned to them and edits only their own profile.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ROLE_CUSTOM: This account has hand-picked permissions that are neither Admin nor User. Choosing a role replaces them.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ROLE_SELF: You can't change your own role, so you can't lock yourself out. Another admin can.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ASSIGN_ADMIN: Admins can open every server, so assignments don't matter for this account.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ASSIGN_USER: Tick the servers this user can open. They won't see any others.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_EMAIL_SIGN_IN: New accounts sign in with their email address.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_ASSIGNED: Users who can open this server. Changes save right away.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_MFA_ENABLED: Your account asks for a code from your authenticator app every time you sign in.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_MFA_PENDING: Your account doesn't have an authenticator app yet. Setup happens on the sign-in screen, so the server checks your password first.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_MFA_OFF: An admin has turned off two-factor sign-in for this account.
BETTERGUAC.STEP_MFA_1: Sign out and sign back in with your email and password.
BETTERGUAC.STEP_MFA_2: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
BETTERGUAC.STEP_MFA_3: Enter the 6-digit code. Once the server accepts it, this panel shows MFA enabled.
BETTERGUAC.TEXT_MFA_SETUP: You'll be signed out. Sign back in with your password, scan the QR code with your authenticator app, and enter the code it shows.
BETTERGUAC.TEXT_ASSIGNED_COUNT: {COUNT, plural, =0{No servers} one{1 server} other{# servers}}
BETTERGUAC.TEXT_NO_PLAIN_USERS: There are no User accounts yet.
BETTERGUAC.TEXT_DELETE_SERVERS: These servers will be deleted for everyone: {NAMES}. This can't be undone.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_GROUP_NAME: A group name can be at most 64 characters.
BETTERGUAC.ERROR_GROUPS_NOT_SAVED: The server was saved, but its groups weren't. Open it again and save once more.
BETTERGUAC.HELP_GROUPS_FIELD: Separate groups with commas. Members of any of these groups can open this server.

SETTINGS_CONNECTIONS.HELP_CONNECTIONS: Click a server to edit it, or add a new one. Assign servers to users from the server's page or the user's page.

SETTINGS_USERS.HELP_USERS: Admins manage users and servers. Users only see the servers assigned to them.

SETTINGS_PREFERENCES.HELP_DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD: The default input method determines how keyboard events are received by BetterGuac. Changing this setting may be necessary when using a mobile device, or when typing through an IME. This setting can be overridden on a per-connection basis within the BetterGuac menu.
SETTINGS_PREFERENCES.HELP_DEFAULT_MOUSE_MODE: The default mouse emulation mode determines how the remote mouse will behave in new connections with respect to touches. This setting can be overridden on a per-connection basis within the BetterGuac menu.
